accountant_is_configured.meaning: the Vault has an Accountant configured

slot_registration_active_before.meaning: an active registration exists for the target BLP slot before the call

slot_readable_and_active_verified.meaning: the supplied slot has been verified readable and active before notifyVaultSupply is called

distributable_surplus_calculation_succee.meaning: the distributableSurplus() calculation required by Gate 3 completes successfully

assumptions: The Accountant configuration and the absence of an active slot registration are both true before the notifyVaultSupply call.
The distributableSurplus() calculation is the Gate 3 prerequisite for yield settlement.

unresolved.description: The intent requires notifyVaultSupply to be called only after verifying the slot is readable and active, but the report does not state that yield settlement completion is the effect of that verification; the required_effect condition/effect pairing is a review-level binding, not a report-stated causal relation.

limitations: The report does not quantify when the later reverting reads occur relative to registration.
Whether HyperCore leaves the slot inactive is conditional and has no deterministic trigger in the report.
The impact is encoded as a Boolean outcome because the report gives no numeric definition of the blocked settlement.
